notes.title: BossAss V1.1.3 is out now! Attach an update description.
notes.content:
Dear Players:

This update focuses on fixing issues and does not add any new features.
We're preparing a little surprise for everyone, and when it's ready, it's going to be presented to you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/3e2b09f9434152d23cdaf95ae32bc0fa17878544.png

The following is the content of this update:

BUG Fix
[olist]
 Fixes an issue that caused the plot text to appear incomplete;
 Fixes an issue where the player immediately becomes stuck when the game is cleared when he ticks Skip The Opening Story;
 Fixes some of the previously discovered abnormal text displays;
[/olist]

Changes
[olist]
 Minor adjustments have been made to the effect of the plot text display;
[/olist]


TOWA Software
October 5, 2020.

notes.title: BossAss V1.1.2 is out now! Attach an update description.
BossAss is now officially released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/e72ba5c3f05333ac832321180dcea6085d0cfe1b.jpg

Dear Players:

We are pleased to announce that Rookie Society Animals will not dream of the boss's ass is now on sale! According to our previous plan, we will discount the game by -40% during the first period, at a discount of RMB ￥6.

The game's producers are live at the moment, so you can go and watch it.

Live address: live.bilibili.com/7998605/ (BiliBIli)

Please don't miss it!

Have fun!



TOWA Software.
Moespirit Studios.

October 3, 2020.


We will add additional languages to the game based on subsequent reactions!

notes.title: Boss Ass will go on sale tonight!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/0997a0443a7ff49566c6dfb0ad3c9cae8c8786a1.png

(This article is the result of automatic translation.)


Dear Players:

As the publisher of our work, we are pleased to announce that the strategy game Boss Ass, developed by TOWA Software, will go on sale tonight!

In Boss Ass, you'll play a budding wage slave, join a long-established start-up, struggle with life in confusion and distress, and finally [strike]dream of the boss's ass[/strike] sitting in the boss's position!
